name: flecha
description: An Arc-style browser built on Chromium (via Electron).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:preload && tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && cp src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css dist/renderer/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2 dist/renderer/fonts/jetbrains-mono.woff2
